title: Polarity setup by process, Vulcan OmniPro 220
note: Polarity INVERTS between solid-wire MIG and self-shielded flux-core on the same gun. This table is the sole authority for which lead enters which socket; every wiring diagram the agent renders is derived from these rows and verified against them.

rows.label: Solid-core MIG (gas shielded)
rows.quote: Ground Clamp Cable in Negative Socket DCEP Solid Core (Gas Shielded) Polarity Setup Wire Feed Power Cable in Positive Socket

rows.label: Flux-cored, self-shielded (gasless)
rows.quote: DCEN Direct Current Electrode Negative Wire Setup for Flux-Cored (gasless) welding: Plug Ground Clamp Cable into Positive (+) Socket. Plug Wire Feed Power Cable into Negative (-) Socket.

rows.label: Optional spool gun (aluminum)
rows.quote: To set up optional Spool Gun (sold separately), plug Ground Clamp Cable into Negative (-) Socket. Plug Wire Feed Power Cable into Positive (+) Socket.

rows.label: DC TIG
rows.quote: 1. Plug Ground Clamp Cable into Positive Socket. Twist clockwise all the way to lock in place. 2. Plug TIG Torch Cable (TIG Torch sold separately) into Negative Socket.

rows.label: Stick (SMAW)
rows.quote: Electrode Holder Cable in Positive Socket Ground Clamp Cable in Negative Socket

corroboration.quote: DCEP for MIG and DCEN for Flux-Cored self-shielded welding
